description: Look up one marketing or data tool (for example Snowflake, Braze, Google Ads or The Trade Desk) in CdpHub's directory: how many of the customer data platforms (CDPs) it tracks list an integration with it, each CDP counted once (both sends data to it and reads from it, only sends, only reads), which CDPs list it in each group and which don't, every listing with its direction, how it runs (server-side, client-side, in the warehouse) and a link to the CDP's own documentation, and the tool's page on cdphub.com. Use it for any question about one tool.

name.description: The tool, for example "Snowflake" or "Google Ads".
